description: WRITE-TIMING, record versus page ownership (rows 1 and 2 are blocked even with ADO 'Jet OLEDB:Database Locking Mode=1', which may be the shared IX_N leaf rather than the data page). Process a is the first opener through an ADODB.Connection with that locking mode (value read back), starts a pessimistic edit by assigning the UNINDEXED field V of row 1 and holds it; process b (DAO) tries with Errors before/after UPDATE V of row 2 (same page, unindexed field), UPDATE N of row 2 (indexed field), UPDATE V of row 64, and INSERT; a CancelUpdate and closes; b repeats row 2 V (control). Asks whether the unindexed-field update on a same-page row is admitted in row mode and blocked in page mode.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
